zh: 新增 Windows 端图片压缩能力，附件发送前可更灵活地控制图片体积。
附件查看、渲染与分享流程继续优化：移动端在启用压缩时也可选择发送原图，第三方分享可自动抓取标题并按 Markdown 填入编辑框。
补充多语言内容，增强 Android 小组件与网络握手回退逻辑，整体体验更稳定。
en: Added image compression support on Windows so attachments can be resized before upload.
Continued refining attachment viewing, rendering, and sharing: mobile can now keep original images even when compression is enabled, and share intents can capture titles into Markdown automatically.
Expanded localized content and improved Android widgets plus handshake fallback behavior for better overall stability.
Added image compression support on Windows.

zh: 移动端启用压缩时也可选择发送原图
附件查看界面支持按类型分类
首次握手失败时支持回退到 HTTP 重试
渲染模块解耦并补足空白行渲染
优化 Android 小组件并补充多语言支持
第三方分享可自动抓取标题并按 Markdown 填入编辑框
en: Mobile can now keep the original image even when compression is enabled.
Attachment viewing now supports type-based grouping.
The first failed handshake can now retry over HTTP.
Rendering has been decoupled and blank-line rendering is more complete.
Improved Android widgets and expanded localization support.
Shared content can now capture page titles and insert them as Markdown automatically.
